chunks.subject: AP Physics 1
chunks.title: Q2 Translation Between Representations (TBR) — 12 points
chunks.content: AP Physics 1 FRQ 2 is Translation Between Representations (TBR), 12 points, scored by lettered sub-points. The TBR task requires moving among representations — words, equations, graphs, diagrams, and data — and using each correctly and consistently. Q2 topic: energy with a spring and gravitation. Points reward: correct free-body/energy diagrams, correct equations linking representations, correctly drawn/labeled graphs (axes, shape, features), and quantitative results consistent across representations. Common failure: a graph with wrong shape or unlabeled axes; an equation inconsistent with the diagram; not translating a described situation into the requested representation.

chunks.content: Q2 (TBR) scored 8/12 — earned most representation points but lost several, commonly graph features (shape/labels) or an equation inconsistent with the diagram. Illustrates a solid response with one or two representations imperfectly translated.

chunks.content: Q2 (TBR) scored 2/12 — earned only a couple of sub-points, losing most representations (graph, equations, and consistent quantitative results). Illustrates a response that cannot translate the situation across representations.
